title: Unemployment Benefit Claims — Claimant Handbook: Certifying Each Benefit Week
content:
Each week of an Unemployment Benefit Claims record is certified separately by the claimant, online, by the phone line or with an agent, and one certification record exists per claim per week ending date. Weeks end on Saturday.

## When a week may be certified

- A week may be certified only on or after the day that is the certification opening offset after the week ending date of the certified week. Days are counted as calendar days from the Saturday week ending date, so the opening day is the following Sunday.
- A week may be certified only while the claim status is active or on hold. A claim that is inactive must be reopened before further weeks are certified, and filed, ineligible, exhausted, closed or withdrawn claims accept no certifications.
- A week may be certified only once per claim.

| Day of the attempt, relative to the Saturday week ending date | Opening condition (one-day offset) |
|---|---|
| The Saturday itself, or earlier | Not yet open |
| The following Sunday or later | Open |

## Timeliness

The certification is timely when the certified date is no later than the certification window after the week ending date, counted in calendar days. A later certification is recorded as late with good cause when a late certification request for that week has been approved and the certified date is within the good-cause limit, and otherwise as late without good cause, which makes the week not payable.

| Certified date | Late certification request for the week approved | Classification |
|---|---|---|
| Within the certification window | — | Timely |
| After the window, within the good-cause limit | Yes | Late with good cause |
| After the window, within the good-cause limit | No | Late without good cause (week not payable) |
| After the good-cause limit | Either | Late without good cause (week not payable) |

## What the claimant answers and reports

The claimant must answer whether they were able and available for full-time work, report gross earnings and hours in the week the work was performed (earnings are reported in the week worked, not the week paid), report vacation, holiday, severance or pension pay, report any refusal of work, and report at least the program's weekly number of work-search contacts.

## Work search

- The work-search requirement is waived during the recall waiver weeks after the effective date when the claim records a definite recall date, and while approved training is recorded as enrolled where the program waives the search in approved training.
- For Extended Benefits (EB) each contact must be a verifiable application to an employer with an opening, and a contact that is not is not counted.
- A week with fewer contacts than required is not payable but does not by itself place the claim on hold.

## Answers that place the claim on hold

An answer that the claimant was not able and available, or that work was refused, places the claim on hold for a nonmonetary determination.

### Hypothetical dates

For a week ending on a Saturday, certification opens on the Sunday after it. Under a 14-day window, the certification is timely through the Saturday two weeks after the week ending date; a certification made the following Sunday is late.
